title: HSBC UK welcomes access to cash statements - About HSBC | HSBC UK
description: HSBC UK today welcome publication of both the Cash Action Group statement on access to cash and the Wholesale Distribution Steering Group’s update on the UK’s Wholesale Cash Distribution network.

headings.text: HSBC UK welcomes access to cash statements

body: Share link to this page on X
Share link to this page on Facebook
Share link to this page on LinkedIn

Commenting on the announcements, Ian Stuart, Chief Executive Officer, HSBC UK said: “We welcome these announcements giving more clarity on how customers’ access to cash will be maintained in a sustainable way and have been supporting work on both these important developments.

“We remain committed to support the UK’s Wholesale Cash Distribution network, to ensure an effective, resilient and sustainable cash infrastructure, which in turn supports continued retail access to cash.”
Neil Fleming, Head of Media Relations, HSBC UK, neil1.fleming@hsbc.com, +44 (0)7384 792051

HSBC UK HSBC UK serves around 15 million customers across the UK, supported by 25,500 colleagues. HSBC UK offers a complete range of retail banking and wealth management to personal and private banking customers, as well as commercial banking for small to medium businesses and large corporates.

HSBC Holdings plc HSBC Holdings plc, the parent company of the HSBC Group, is headquartered in London. HSBC serves customers worldwide from offices in 64 countries and territories in our geographical regions: Europe, Asia, North America, Latin America, the Middle East and North Africa. With assets of US$2,969 billion at 30 September 2021, HSBC is one of the world’s largest banking and financial services organisations.
